set.132: For the management activity and the services referred to in Article 2, the Property Manager is entitled to a fee equal to 20% (twenty per cent) of the Overnight Stay Price of each booking, plus VAT. “Overnight Stay Price” means the price of the nights due from the Guest, as shown in the booking, net of the commissions withheld by the booking platforms and of the cleaning costs relating to the stay, and excluding the tourist tax, any security deposit and the service fees charged to the Guest by the platforms.
set.135: Without prejudice to this Article and to Articles 13, 14 and 17, nothing further shall be due from the Principal to the Property Manager.
set.176: Each Party may withdraw from the Agreement by written notice sent to the other Party by registered letter with return receipt or certified e-mail (PEC), with 2 (two) months’ notice. The withdrawal shall take effect from the last day of the second calendar month following the month in which the notice was received by the other Party.
set.184: For Future Bookings the Property Manager has carried out the promotion and acquisition activity but does not manage the related stays, which pass to the Principal as provided in this Article. For this activity the Principal shall pay the Property Manager a flat-rate fee (the “End-of-Mandate Fee”) equal to 30% (thirty per cent) of the fee that would have been due to the Property Manager under Article 11 for the nights after the termination date, plus VAT. The End-of-Mandate Fee is therefore 30% of the amount obtained by applying the percentage set out in Article 11 to the Overnight Stay Price.

16.text: The Parties already have a working relationship for the management of the Property, which they intend to regulate in an updated form by this Agreement, also following the Property Manager’s carrying on of its business as a company;

184.text: By way of example, where Future Bookings total 8 nights with an Overnight Stay Price of EUR 100.00 each (EUR 800.00 in total), the Property Manager’s fee under Article 11 would be EUR 160.00 (20% of EUR 800.00) and the End-of-Mandate Fee is EUR 48.00 (30% of EUR 160.00), plus VAT.
